plugins.name: Better Cores
plugins.summary: The tunnel cores of the panel at a glance: installed, running, last release of each project (olcRTC: the ghostlane-project fork); no page of its own; the base Better OpenFlux and Better olcRTC need
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Reads the panel's status of the tunnel cores (no download, upload or logs); asks GitHub's public releases API for the last release of each project (network); changes nothing.

plugins.name: Better CSQTT
plugins.summary: One CSQTT password per person: each client of the inbound gets a member and their own link, so several people can use CSQTT at once
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Reads the CSQTT inbound and its clients; calls the CSQTT server's own web API with its web password (network); only members it made are touched; falls back to the shared link.

plugins.name: Better LucX
plugins.summary: Links of any scheme in the client form, AmneziaWG link, plain CSQTT links, names on the subscription page
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Reads clients and inbounds; takes part in subscription and clients API answers (seam:sub, seam:api:clients); links kept in its data dir; no network. Falls back to the panel.

plugins.name: Better olcRTC
plugins.summary: Replaces the panel's olcRTC core by the ghostlane-project fork (SaluteJazz, VK Calls, MTS Link, several keys, UDP); needs Better Cores
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Only the olcRTC core routes (status, download by hash, remove); the panel checks the hash; core built from the fork's tag v0.12.1; no network permission.

plugins.name: Better OpenFlux
plugins.summary: Keeps the panel's OpenFlux core at v0.13.0 (more carriers, several links per carrier, l3)
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Only the OpenFlux core routes (status, download by hash, remove); the panel downloads and checks the hash; core built from upstream v0.13.0.
